facts: The member already had 3 refunds in the last 12 months.
masked_input.policy_clause: Members in good standing can receive up to 3 fee refunds in any 12-month period. The 12 months end on the date of the fee being reviewed, and refunds of any fee type count.

response.reply: Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for reaching out about the $35 Courtesy Pay fee charged to Everyday Checking on Sep 14. We can refund up to three fees of any type in the 12 months ending on the fee date. Our review confirmed that you've already received three refunds during that period, so we can't refund this fee. If you need anything else, please reply to this message.
